about.desc: Preview, tag, group and snapshot thousands of fonts, install them with a double click, enable or disable any family in one click — all offline, with duplicate detection and license notes. Your font files always stay on your machine.Installable plugins, a local HTTP API and MCP support let you wire font power into other tools.

tour.card.body: The pill switch activates or deactivates it system-wide — deactivated fonts vanish from other apps' pickers but stay in your library. Star favorites, right-click for everything else.
tour.card.title: A font family
tour.collections.body: Group fonts per project or client — “Client X”, “Personal brand”. Create one here, then right-click any font to add it.
tour.collections.title: Collections
tour.inspector.body: Click any font to open this panel: switch styles, drag variable axes, browse every glyph, export files, read the license. Drag its edge to resize.
tour.resize.title: A panel that fits
tour.resize.body: Drag the inspector's left edge to widen it — double-click the edge to reset. The charset line shows real numbers (total characters · Han glyphs), so “no Chinese” is a fact you can verify, not a guess.
tour.inspector.title: The inspector
tour.inviteSub: A one-minute tour of your new font library.
tour.last.body: Drag font files, folders, or zip archives anywhere onto this window to install them. That's it — enjoy your library.
tour.last.title: One last thing
tour.sample.body: Type anything here and the whole library re-renders in it. Try your brand name or that headline you're setting.
tour.sample.title: Your words, every font
tour.search.body: Search by name, tag, format, foundry — even your own notes. Press / from anywhere to jump here.
tour.scripts.title: Filter by writing system
tour.scripts.body: The funnel filters by format, class and language. Chinese and Japanese are separate options — a family only counts when its glyphs really cover the script, so a Latin font with a handful of hanzi won't slip through. Partial coverage is flagged as such.
tour.weights.title: Every weight, at a glance
tour.weights.body: Click a card to unfold all its weights. Their size follows the preview slider, hovering a weight instantly re-renders the big sample in it, and the pen button applies that weight right away.
tour.hints.title: Honest about missing glyphs
tour.hints.body: If a family can't draw your sample text, the card says so outright — and when a sibling family carries the glyphs (like HarmonyOS Sans SC next to the Latin-only HarmonyOS Sans), it points you straight to it.
tour.search.title: Find anything
tour.settings.body: Pick your language, watch folders for new fonts, add extra scan locations, tune motion and sounds.
tour.settings.title: Settings
tour.size.body: Drag from caption-small to poster-huge. The scale is stepped so useful sizes are easy to hit.
tour.size.title: Preview size
tour.trash.body: Uninstalled fonts land in the trash, not the void. Restore them any time.
tour.trash.title: Nothing is ever lost
tour.views.body: Grid for browsing, list for managing, specimen to compare typefaces at a glance.
tour.views.title: Three ways to look
tour.welcome.body: Every font on this machine, in one place — preview, organize, activate, and install. This tour takes about a minute.
tour.welcome.title: Welcome to FontManager

Delete {label}?
